source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master title names a standard read but Procedure and Criteria are TBD and boilerplate clears logs. DeepSeek refuses execution; GPT V2 supplies a plausible standard mapping that still requires explicit target/schema approval.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Unlike an unknown setter, the title identifies a bounded read-only repository-information function with a standard candidate command. Approval of target applicability and schema is an execution-readiness input rather than a permanent semantic contradiction.

review_improvement: Preserves the TBD source while giving a constrained, explicitly conditional read-only implementation and measurable metadata oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: The named operation is a finite telemetry query and can be deterministic once the target's standard command/schema mapping is approved; therefore FULLY AUTOMATABLE is justified without claiming Master correction or DUT PASS.
